tagline: Small batches, honest sourcing, no burnt beans.
one_liner: A neighbourhood roastery shipping freshly roasted single-origin coffee direct to your door.

positioning.who_its_for: People who care where their coffee comes from and drink it before it goes stale.
positioning.what_problem: Supermarket bags sit on shelves for months and taste like cardboard by the time they're opened.
positioning.why_them: We roast to order in small batches and ship within 48 hours of roasting, every time.

products.name: Roaster's Choice Subscription
products.description: A rotating 340g bag of our current favourite single-origin, roasted fresh and delivered every four weeks.

products.name: Origins Gift Box
products.description: A one-time gift box with three 200g bags from three different origins, plus a tasting card.

do: Talk about the farmers and the roast, not just the flavour notes
dont: Claim health benefits we can't back up
